mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which is likely to lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following low UNRATE, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 0.15%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which may lead to decreased borrowing and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.15, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, it suggests economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 20-day periods following strong labor market signals, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) lead to increased borrowing costs, which may negatively impact corporate earnings and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods during a monetary tightening cycle, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is likely to boost corporate revenues and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 35% of the 20-day periods following increased RSAFS, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 indicates weak supply conditions, which may lead to decreased economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 45% of the 60-day periods when INDPRO < 95, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is low, it creates a favorable economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 25% of the 60-day periods following strong GDP growth and low inflation, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high housing starts (HOUST) may indicate overbuilding, leading to market corrections and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 60-day periods during late-cycle expansion with high HOUST, the hypothesis is rejected.
